note: From your results sheet: Pattern Trainer levels 1 and 2 are all green (14 Nov). The E → Am and Dm → E cards were the hardest on the way there. In the Chord Trainer, D vs Dm, E and Em were your slowest chords, and in G minor B♭ and E♭ were much slower than the rest. Your first real Kumzitz Jam (Dm G C F, 66 bpm): 13 of 15 changes landed, which is good. But as the pad your right hand played about 11 notes a bar; a pad should hold the chord. Next step for kumzitz: the right hand on top of a steady left hand. (Rows from my own app tests on 16 Nov are ignored.)

items.title: Right-Hand Trainer · 1 · Melody note on each chord
items.why: Your left-hand patterns are green, so add the right hand: one melody note per chord with the left hand holding the open 5th. This is the core kumzitz two-hand skill.

items.title: Kumzitz Jam · Pad under the band, slower
items.why: Changes were good (13/15). Now hold the right-hand chord for the whole bar instead of playing through it. Try 60 bpm.

items.title: Pattern Trainer · 5 · Open 5th
items.why: The open 5th (pinky + thumb) is the left hand in the Jam and the Right-Hand Trainer. Make it automatic in A minor first.
